observations.dense_loop_shape: 128 trips, four independent YMM chains covering 32 neurons, four mulps/addps pairs, one input broadcast and four loop-control instructions per trip; no FMA
observations.hidden_output_shape: scalar clamp comparisons/conditional branches then original linear 32-term output reduction
observations.limitation: RIP samples are coarse, suspension/inlining biased and not hardware cache, branch or cycle counters. No precise stall cause is inferred.

unroll4: One loop unroll_count(4) pragma on the existing 128-input dense loop. Interleave independent neuron work but retain each neuron's j=0..127 addition order. Test code-size/register tradeoffs rather than assuming fewer branch instructions mean faster search.
hiddenclip: Apply existing Stage 1 operand-ordered AVX clip_inputs to the 32 hidden outputs in place, then retain the original sequential output multiply/add reduction. Input clipping and the dense loop stay unchanged. Validate against frozen production Stage 1 mixed NaN-payload outputs as well as the original suite.
scope: Private copies of stage1_head.hpp only; no weights, architecture, search, accumulator, fallback or production changes.
